statement_summary: Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30; product risks also in the design risk file
Risk acceptance authority; High patient-safety risks never accepted without remediation
Security requirements, threat modeling, testing, and SBOM in every device and device cloud release
Sanctions for policy violations
No BAA, no PHI (subcontractor BAAs)
Annual control evaluation and annual independent testing of the device cloud
Six-year retention of security documentation and CVD records
Unique accounts; shared MES logins only under a time-limited exception
No standing production access to PHI; ticket-approved time-limited access
MFA everywhere; hardware keys for privileged cloud roles
Same-day access removal at termination
Quarterly access reviews, including production roles and signing rights
Two-person release signing; backup administration separate from production
No default, hardcoded, or shared device credentials; unique device identity
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Published CVD policy; 3-business-day acknowledgment; ISAO participation
Controlled or uncontrolled risk assessment; documented MDR and 806 decisions
Out-of-cycle fixes for uncontrolled risks; customer notice within 30 days
Business associate breach notice to hospitals within 60 days or BAA terms; Florida 10-day agent notice
Annual incident response tabletop
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Signing keys in an HSM or non-exportable key service; split backup shares
PHI only in approved systems; masked before logs leave the device cloud
Restricted data inventory and machine-readable SBOM for each release
Separated, immutable, encrypted backups restore-tested quarterly
Annual awareness training; quarterly phishing exercises; role training for engineers
Approved AI tools only; no source code or PHI in public AI tools
